exceptions.evidence: All 23 rated sources, including unit coefficients, signed coefficients/frequencies, rational and pi bounds, radicals, cancellation, symmetry and nonzero lower bounds, are moderate. The package preserves one full IBP setup, a remaining elementary integral and exact endpoint evaluation. Larger/smaller coefficients do not establish a calibrated different band. Adding repeated IBP or deleting the assessed steps changes the extracted backbone. No independently validated easy/hard template is available. This is a bounded content capability, not a claim that such a level is mathematically impossible. New source evidence reopens classification.
